title: Universality and sharp thresholds for ellipsoid fitting
abstract: arXiv:2608.27372v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We establish a sharp phase transition for fitting random vectors by an ellipsoid. The random vectors have independent subgaussian coordinates with mean zero, variance one, and a common fourth moment, and the number of vectors is proportional to the square of the dimension. We identify an explicit satisfiability threshold such that, with high probability, a positive definite ellipsoid passes through every data point below the threshold, whereas no positive semidefinite fit exists above it. We also determine the optimal squared fitting error throughout the unsatisfiable regime. In particular, the threshold depends on the coordinate distributions only through their common fourth moment, revealing a fourth moment universality phenomenon. For standard Gaussian data the threshold is $1/4$, resolving the ellipsoid fitting conjecture.

translated_title: 椭球拟合的普适性与尖锐阈值
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.27372v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们建立了用椭球拟合随机向量的尖锐相变。随机向量具有独立的亚高斯坐标，均值为零，方差为一，且具有共同的四阶矩，向量的数量与维数的平方成正比。我们确定了一个显式的可满足性阈值，使得在高概率下，当数据点数量低于该阈值时，存在一个正定椭球穿过每个数据点；而当高于该阈值时，不存在正半定拟合。我们还确定了在不可满足区域内的最优平方拟合误差。特别地，该阈值仅依赖于坐标分布的共同四阶矩，揭示了四阶矩普适性现象。对于标准高斯数据，该阈值为$1/4$，解决了椭球拟合猜想。
tldr: 本文揭示了椭球拟合中的四阶矩普适性，并确定了尖锐相变阈值，解决了标准高斯数据下的椭球拟合猜想。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals a fourth-moment universality in ellipsoid fitting and identifies a sharp phase transition threshold, resolving the ellipsoid fitting conjecture for standard Gaussian data.
